auth.signInSubtitle: Use your e-mail and password to continue.
auth.name: Name
auth.confirmSentBody: If the e-mail is registered, we sent a confirmation link.
auth.verifyOk: E-mail confirmed. Sign in to begin.
auth.verifyFail: The link is not valid or has expired. Request a new one on the sign-in page.

errors.generic: Could not continue. Please try again.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 12 characters and not one of the most used.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid e-mail, such as name@company.com.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue where you left off.

chat.inputPlaceholder: Ask about fees, card machine, Pix, receivables advance…
chat.verifying: Checking the answer against the sources…
chat.rateLimited: Too many messages in a short time. Wait {{seconds}} s before sending again.

errors.interrupted: The answer was interrupted before it finished. Please send your question again.
errors.generic: I could not answer right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.notLinked: Your account is not linked to an establishment yet. Ask the administrator to link it.
errors.invalid: I couldn't send this message. Check the text (up to 4,000 characters) and try again.

chat.handoffLockPlaceholder: Waiting for a human agent to reply…
chat.handoffLockHint: While the ticket is with a human agent, new messages are blocked.

handoff.waitingBody: Your request is in the queue as ticket {{ticket}}.
handoff.slaTitle: The reply is taking longer than usual
handoff.slaBody: We've bumped the priority; the agent's reply will appear here as soon as it arrives.
handoff.resolvedBody: A human agent replied to your request.
handoff.expiredBody: We couldn't attend in time. If you still need help, send a new message.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: You control your data at any time. Pick one of the actions below.
privacy.deleteConvsBody: Removes the chat history and the associated checkpoints. Your account stays active.
privacy.deleteAccountBody: Deletes conversations, name, e-mail and password. Unlinks your establishment (the establishment data stays because it is not yours). The audit trail is kept, pseudonymised.
privacy.confirmHelp: This action only runs when the text matches {{word}}.

history.title: Your conversations
history.emptyBody: Start a conversation to see it listed here.

queue.title: Handoff queue
queue.emptyBody: No tickets waiting for an agent.

ticket.title: Ticket detail
ticket.pendingActionBody: The merchant asked for an action that needs operator approval: {{type}}.
ticket.missingDecision: Choose approve or reject before sending.
ticket.replyPlaceholder: Explain what was done or the next step
ticket.alreadyClosed: This ticket has already been closed.
ticket.noMessages: No messages recorded for this ticket.
ticket.notInQueue: This ticket is no longer in the queue. It may have been answered or closed.

home.title: Administration
home.subtitle: Invite operators and admins, link accounts to establishments and watch the queue and audit.
home.linkBody: Link a merchant account to an existing establishment.
home.auditBody: Security and authorship events; merchant actors are pseudonymised where applicable.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.emptyBody: Adjust the filters or invite a new one.
accounts.deactivateConfirmBody: This revokes every active session. Are you sure?

link.title: Link merchant to establishment
link.subtitle: Enter the establishment ID (e.g. cliente1988) and pick the merchant account.
link.conflict: This establishment is already linked to another account.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.subtitle: Set your name and password to activate the account.
invite.name: Name
invite.ok: Account activated. Sign in with your new password.
invite.fail: The invitation is not valid or has expired. Ask the admin for a new one.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.body: You don't have permission to open this page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address you opened does not exist.

loadError.title: Could not load
loadError.body: The data did not arrive. Check your connection and try again.
loadError.staleBody: What is on screen may be out of date.

routeError.title: Something went wrong on this page
routeError.body: The error was ours, not yours. Reload the page to try again.
routeError.outdatedBody: The system was updated while this tab was open. Reload the page to continue.
